svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Waymo taps Toyota to supply robotaxis for Japan and the U.K. ◆ You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work ◆ Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’ ◆ AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big ◆ Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto ◆ Elon Musk is ‘truly a genius,’ says Vladimir Putin ◆
